description: Source code for handling column display and formatting in a terminal, including layout calculations, configuration parsing, and subprocess management for column filtering.

methods.name: item_length
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a string in UTF-8 characters, ignoring ANSI escape sequences.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Calculates the number of rows and columns for displaying a list of items in a table format based on available width.

methods.name: compute_column_width
methods.description: Determines the maximum width for each column based on item lengths.

methods.name: shrink_columns
methods.description: Reduces the number of rows and adjusts columns to fit within the total width.

methods.name: display_plain
methods.description: Displays list items in plain format with indentation and newline.

methods.name: display_cell
methods.description: Prints a single cell in the table with proper spacing.

methods.name: display_table
methods.description: Displays a list of items as a formatted table according to layout options.

methods.name: print_columns
methods.description: Main function to print a list of strings in columnar format based on options.

methods.name: finalize_colopts
methods.description: Adjusts column options based on whether output is a TTY or pager is in use.

methods.name: parse_option
methods.description: Parses individual column options from command-line arguments.

methods.name: parse_config
methods.description: Parses a string of comma/space-separated column configuration options.

methods.name: column_config
methods.description: Configures column options based on variable and value.

methods.name: git_column_config
methods.description: Handles configuration for column options, including 'ui' and command-specific settings.

methods.name: parseopt_column_callback
methods.description: Callback for parsing column options from command-line options.

methods.name: run_column_filter
methods.description: Starts a subprocess to filter column output, configuring arguments and pipes.

methods.name: stop_column_filter
methods.description: Stops the column filter subprocess and restores stdout.
